div.head: II Cn 4.2
div.ab: And þeofas ⁊ þeodsceaðan to tíman forweorðan, butan hig geswican.
⁊ ðeofas ⁊ ðeodsceaðan to tíman forwurðan, buton hi geswican.
And þeofas ⁊ ðeods[c]eaðan to timan forwyrþan, buton hig geswican.
[4, 2] And þeofan ⁊ þeodscaðan to timan forwurðan, buton hig geswican.
Fures et eiusmodi dampna populi propediem pereant, nisi (si non) conquiescant.
Fures et latrones sine dilacione pereant, nisi tempore cessent.
⁊ ðeofas ⁊ ðeodsceaðan to tíman forwurðan, buton hi geswican.
And þeofas and þeodsceaðan to timan forweorðan butan hig geswican.
Und Diebe und öffentliche Räuber sollen alsbald untergehen, falls sie nicht [vom Bösen] abstehen.
And let thieves and public robbers perish forthwith, unless they desist [from evil].
And thieves and robbers shall forthwith be made an end of, unless they desist.
And thieves and criminals will henceforth be destroyed unless they cease their crimes.

Für 4, 2, fortgesetzt in 6. 7, lag Cn vielleicht eine mit dem Interpolator von Wulfstans Predigt a. 1014 (ed. Napier 165) gemeinsame Quelle vor: Er eifert gegen mannslagan, .. apostatan, mánswaran, morðorwyrhtan, hádbrecan, æwbrecan .., wiccan, .. ryperas, reaferas, þeofas, þeodscaðan, wedlogan ⁊ wærlogan. In die Hölle stossen mannslagan, æwbrecan, mánsworan, morðwyrhtan, ryperas, reaferas, þeofas, þeodscaðan, wiccan ⁊ wigleras Hom. n. Wulfstan 26. 114. 203. 298. 309; Polity 435. Ein anderer, der VI Atr 7 oder II Cn 4 benutzt, mahnt das Land zu säubern: her syndan on earde godcundnessæ wiðersacan, manslagan, .. hadbrecan ⁊ æwbrecan .., þeofas ⁊ þeodscaðan, ryperas ⁊ reaferas, leogeras ⁊ liceteras; ähnlich ein anderer 266. Auch in Dichtung stehen þeofas ⁊ þeodsceaðan; Crist 1609.—Vgl. Gl Diebstahl 5; Raub 2.—Zum schwachen No. pl. in D vgl. Wb S. 48 Sp. 2 und mittelengl. Gen. þeovene Stratmann Wb

For 4, 2, continued in 6. 7, Cn perhaps had before him a source shared with the interpolator of Wulfstan’s sermon of 1014 (ed. Napier 165): he inveighs against mannslagan, .. apostatan, mánswaran, morðorwyrhtan, hádbrecan, æwbrecan .., wiccan, .. ryperas, reaferas, þeofas, þeodscaðan, wedlogan ⁊ wærlogan. Cast into hell are mannslagan, æwbrecan, mánsworan, morðwyrhtan, ryperas, reaferas, þeofas, þeodscaðan, wiccan ⁊ wigleras Hom. n. Wulfstan 26. 114. 203. 298. 309; Polity 435. Another writer, who uses VI Atr 7 or II Cn 4, urges that the land be cleansed: her syndan on earde godcundnessæ wiðersacan, manslagan, .. hadbrecan ⁊ æwbrecan .., þeofas ⁊ þeodscaðan, ryperas ⁊ reaferas, leogeras ⁊ liceteras; similarly another 266. Poetry too has þeofas ⁊ þeodsceaðan; Crist 1609. — Cf. Gl Diebstahl 5; Raub 2. — On the weak nom. pl. in D cf. Wb p. 48 col. 2 and the Middle English gen. þeovene Stratmann Wb
